name: Irelia
title: the Blade Dancer

Q.name: Bladesurge
Q.description: Irelia dashes to an enemy, dealing 5/25/45/65/85 + 0.8×AD physical damage and restoring 0.09/0.1/0.11/0.12/0.13×AD Health to herself. If the enemy dies or was Unsteady, the Cooldown is refreshed. Deals 5/25/45/65/85 + 50+ (by level) + 0.8×AD damage to minions.
Q.summary: Irelia dashes forward to strike her target, healing herself. If the target is Marked or dies to Bladesurge, its cooldown refreshes.

W.name: Defiant Dance
W.description: Begin Charging: Irelia enters a defensive stance for up to 1.5 seconds, becoming unable to act but reducing physical damage taken by 40–70 (by level) + 0.08×AP% and magic damage taken by (40–70 (by level) + 0.08×AP) × 0.5%. Release: Irelia lashes out with her blades, dealing 10/20/30/40/50 + 0.4×AD + 0.5×AP physical damage increased up to 30/60/90/120/150 + 1.2×AD + 1.5×AP based on charge time.
W.summary: Irelia charges a strike that deals more damage as she charges. She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.

E.name: Flawless Duet
E.description: Irelia throws a blade into the ground and can Recast for up to 3.5 seconds. Recast: Irelia throws a second blade, then they fly towards each other Stunning for 0.75 seconds and dealing 70/110/150/190/230 + 1×AP magic damage. Champions and large jungle monsters become Unsteady for 5 seconds.
E.summary: Irelia sends out two blades which converge on each other. Enemies caught in between are damaged, stunned and Marked.

R.name: Vanguard's Edge
R.description: Irelia launches a barrage of blades, dealing 125/200/275 + 1×AP magic damage and making champions and large jungle monsters Unsteady for 5 seconds. The barrage explodes into a cage around the first champion hit for 2.5 seconds. The cage deals 125/200/275 + 1×AP magic damage and Slows by 90% for 1.5 seconds.
R.summary: Irelia fires a massive number of blades that explode outward upon hitting an enemy champion. Enemies hit by the blades are damaged and Marked. Afterwards the blades form a wall that will damage and slow enemies that walk through it.

Passive.name: Ionian Fervor
Passive.description: When Irelia strikes enemies with spells she gains stacking bonus Attack Speed. At maximum stacks she also gains bonus damage on hit.
Passive.summary: When Irelia strikes enemies with spells she gains stacking bonus Attack Speed. At maximum stacks she also gains bonus damage on hit.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Dive skirmisher who resets Q on marked or dying targets, stacks passive attack speed, and stuns with E.
strengths: Q resets on minions give huge mobility
Passive max stacks wins extended trades
E stun and R marks enable all-ins
weaknesses: Punished by CC during Q chains
Low early waveclear without Q resets
profile.curveNote: Wants passive stacked from minion Qs before trading.
profile.waveClear: medium – Q resets on last hits

Q.notes: Dash to target; refreshes on marked or killed targets

Passive.notes: Stacks from spells; on-hit damage at max

profile.windowAgainst: Passive not stacked or E down.
checks: Q dodgeable? It is not an attack but applies on-hit (check)
